# Copilot Session Discovery

Discovers local GitHub Copilot CLI sessions on the host machine and surfaces each as an `agent-definition` entity (using the session's GUID directory name as the entity-id). Also reads the Copilot MCP configuration file and registers each installed MCP server as an `mcp-server` entity scoped under the current machine's `computer-user-profiles/…/copilot/mcp-servers` name path so machine-specific MCP servers can be referenced by name from agent manifest tool resources.

## Configuration

Read from the tool entity's top-level properties:

| Key | Type | Semantics |
|---|---|---|
| `session-state-root` | string | Overrides the Copilot session-state root directory. Defaults to `<user home>/.copilot/session-state` (user home is `USERPROFILE` when set, otherwise the OS user-profile folder). |
| `mcp-config-path` | string | Overrides the Copilot MCP configuration file path. Defaults to `<user home>/.copilot/mcp-config.json`. |

## Usage

Wire the tool via a `tool-relationship`:

- `participants.tool` — the entity-id of this tool entity.
- `participants.schedule` — a `schedule` entity controlling scan cadence (a short interval is fine — the tool only touches the local filesystem and a config file).
- `participants.target` — typically not needed; the tool derives the machine and user from the current execution context.

Set `paused: true` on the relationship to disable it. Because entity-ids for MCP servers are deterministic per machine + server name, re-runs upsert rather than duplicate.
